## Load in dataset and statistical summary

```{r}
##https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/lashagoch/life-expectancy-who-updated

library(readr)
```

## Visualization Plot 1 + 2

```{r}

###Life Expectancy Differences: 
#1: Average life expectancy in 2002 and 2012 for developing and developed countries to show change over 10 year period and difference
    #between developed and developing countries
#2: Change in life expectancy 2000-2015 by region
      

library("ggplot2")

TenYr <- filter(life_expectancy, Year == 2012 | Year == 2002)
View(TenYr)

TenYrLife <- TenYr %>% group_by(Year, Status) %>% summarise(Avg_Life = mean(`Life_expectancy`), SD = sd(Life_expectancy))
View(TenYrLife)

TenYrLife <- mutate(TenYrLife, Label = paste0(Year, Status))

ggplot(TenYrLife, aes(x = Label, y = Avg_Life, fill = Status)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity") + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Avg_Life - SD, ymax = Avg_Life + SD)) + geom_text(aes(label = paste0("±", round(SD, 2)), y = Avg_Life + SD + 0.5)) + labs(x = "Year and Country Status", y = "Average Life Expectancy", title = "10 Year Difference (2002 -- 2012) in Life Expectancy Between Developed and Developing Countries") + theme_minimal()

#Calculate Average Life Expectancy by Region Per Year
Avg_Life_Region <- life_expectancy %>% group_by(Region, Year) %>% summarize(Average_LE = mean(Life_expectancy))
View(Avg_Life_Region)
ggplot(Avg_Life_Region, aes(x = Year, y = Average_LE, color = Region)) + geom_line(size = 2) + labs(x = "Year", y = "Average Life Expectancy", title = "Average Life Expectancy by Region, 2000-2015")

```

## Model 1

```{r}

Life_Model <- lm(formula = Life_expectancy~GDP_per_capita + Schooling + BMI + Alcohol_consumption, data = life_expectancy)
Life_Model

summary(Life_Model)

predictions <- predict(Life_Model, newdata = life_expectancy)

mae <- mean(abs(life_expectancy$Life_expectancy - predictions))
mae

plot(life_expectancy$Life_expectancy, predictions, xlab = "Observed Life Expectancy", ylab = "Predicted Life Expectancy", main = "Actual vs Predicted Life Expectancy by Country, 2000-2015")
abline(0, 1, col = "red")


```

## Model 2

```{r}

library("caret")

sample_size_glm <- floor(0.8 * nrow(life_expectancy))
sample_size_glm

#Index of training samples
train_index_glm <- sample(seq_len(nrow(life_expectancy)), 
                      size = sample_size_glm)

#Generate training and testing datasets
train_glm <- life_expectancy[train_index_glm,]
test_glm <- life_expectancy[-train_index_glm,]
head(train_glm)
head(test_glm)

#Train model
Status_Model <- glm(Economy_status_Developed~Hepatitis_B+Measles+Polio+Diphtheria+Thinness_ten_nineteen_years+Thinness_five_nine_years+GDP_per_capita, family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = train_glm)
summary(Status_Model)

#Run prediction and convert to probability of status, where 1 = developed, 0 = developing
predicted_probs <- predict(Status_Model, newdata = test_glm, type = "response")
predicted_status <- ifelse(predicted_probs > 0.5, 1, 0)

#Analyse prediction using confusion matrix (true pos, true neg, false pos, false neg) + accuracy given by matrix
confusion_matrix <- table(Predicted = predicted_status, Actual = test_glm$Economy_status_Developed)
print(confusion_matrix)

```

## Model 3 

```{r}

library("randomForest")

sample_size_rf <- floor(0.6 * nrow(life_expectancy))
sample_size_rf

train_index_rf <- sample(seq_len(nrow(life_expectancy)), size = sample_size_rf)
train_rf <- life_expectancy[train_index_rf, ]
test_rf <- life_expectancy[-train_index_rf, ]

fitControl <- trainControl(method = "repeatedcv", number = 5)

rf_model <- train(Life_expectancy ~ Infant_deaths + Incidents_HIV + Adult_mortality + GDP_per_capita,
                         data = train_rf, method = "rf", trControl = fitControl, ntree = 100)

rf_predictions <- predict(rf_model, newdata = test_rf)

mse <- mean((rf_predictions - test_rf$Life_expectancy)^2)
rmse <- sqrt(mse)
rmse

importance_rf <- varImp(rf_model, scale = TRUE)  # Scale ensures relative importance
print(importance_rf)

```

## Model 4 

```{r}

library("e1071")

life_expectancy$Status <- as.factor(life_expectancy$Status)

set.seed(123)  
train_indices_svm <- sample(1:nrow(life_expectancy), size = 0.7 * nrow(life_expectancy))
train_data_svm <- life_expectancy[train_indices_svm, ]
test_data_svm <- life_expectancy[-train_indices_svm, ]

svm_model <- svm(Status ~ Schooling + BMI + Alcohol_consumption + Measles, data = train_data_svm,
  kernel = "polynomial", cost = 1, scale = TRUE)

svm_predictions <- predict(svm_model, newdata = test_data_svm)

confusion_svm <- confusionMatrix(svm_predictions, test_data_svm$Status)
print(confusion_svm)


```
